default_backend.description: Default backend(s) to use for PackageKit, as chosen in the configure script. Comma-separated list. 'auto' allows automatic selection.

backend_shutdown_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait before unlocking the backend after it becomes idle.

shutdown_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait before shutting down the daemon when idle. Set to 0 to disable shutdown.

keep_cache.description: Whether to keep downloaded package files in the cache after installation.
